text:
tina_support: Heads up - HelioMaps flagged a weird line on their April bill. They have a 6-node reserved commit but the bill shows ~48 node-hours billed as burst across two short windows (04/04 and 04/07). Can ops/finance take a look before CS replies?

ryan_fin: Thanks Tina. Can you drop the invoice snippet and the reserved pool identifier? I'll stand by to see the metering breakdown.

tina_support: Invoice INV-2026-0407 in support ticket HM-7788. Reserved pool id: hm-reserve-6. Billing snippet from ticket:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0407
Period: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30
Line items:
 - Reserved capacity (hm-reserve-6): 6 nodes - $12,000
 - Burst usage (burst-unallocated): 48 node-hours - $720
 - Storage / egress: $90
Total: $12,810
```

billing-bot: Metering summary attached for org helio-77; see attached meter_export_2026_04_07.csv

omar_ops: I grabbed the allocation logs for the two windows. There's a cross-region metering shard mismatch: some us-east-1 metering shards labeled the pool as "hm-reserve-6" while us-west-2 had a legacy alias "hm-reserve6" (missing hyphen). Our aggregator treats aliases as separate pools unless a mapping exists -> those hours flowed to burst-unallocated. Looks like a region config drift during the 2026-04-01 agent rollout.

chris_engineering: Confirming Omar's findings. The shard mapping table failed to sync for a subset of regions due to a TTL bug in the config service; it expired mapping entries for older pool aliases. I can export a definitive CSV: node_id, region, ts, seen_tag, meter_id. Will include which rows qualify for safe retagging.

emma_sales: From the account side we want a quick remediation + a customer note. HelioMaps is a large logo; keep it tight and proactive. If there's any customer-facing credit, sales needs to approve the amount before finance posts.

lina_revops: For audit: we'll need the exported CSV and any backfill job ids attached to the revops ticket. Also state reason code for credits if we adjust.

ryan_fin: Estimate the billing delta once we have the CSV. Also note finance policy: manager-level approval up to $2,500; anything above requires VP sign-off. Please propose two numbers: invoice correction and optional SLA goodwill.

chris_engineering: CSV export attached (helio_meter_alias_mismatch_04_07.csv). Quick summary: 48 node-hours incorrectly attributed -> gross delta $640. Breakdown shows 32 hours in us-east and 16 in us-west. All rows flagged as safe to retag.

omar_ops: We're prepping a backfill job to re-associate those meter rows with hm-reserve-6. Backfill id: bf-2026-412. It'll run as a safe operation limited to the 2 windows. Patch to config service deployed to prevent TTL expiry.

emma_sales: On customer phrasing: propose we offer invoice correction ($640) + one-time SLA goodwill $1,500 for disruption and relationship. Total proposed $2,140. Sales approves that amount.

ryan_fin: That fits manager approval. I'll approve up to $2,500. Please proceed with two credit memos: (1) invoice adj CM-2026-102 for $640, reason METER_SHARD_ALIAS; (2) service credit CM-2026-103 for $1,500, reason GOODWILL_SLA. Accounting note: post to April ledger.

infra-bot: Patch rollout summary: config-service v2.9.4 deployed to all regions. No impact to production CPU.

lina_revops: Recorded revops ticket revops-812 with attachment helio_meter_alias_mismatch_04_07.csv and backfill bf-2026-412. Tagging audit trail saved.

tina_support: Draft to customer (short): "We identified a metering alias mismatch that caused 48 node-hours to be billed as burst instead of your reserved pool. We've corrected the records, issued a $640 invoice adjustment and a $1,500 service credit for the disruption. Patch deployed to prevent recurrence. Apologies for the inconvenience; credit memos will appear on your account within 48h." Will send after finance confirms memos posted.

ryan_fin: Credit memos created and queued: CM-2026-102 ($640) and CM-2026-103 ($1,500). I'll route to AP now.

billing-bot: Credits posted to account helio-77: CM-2026-102, CM-2026-103. Expected ledger posting date: 2026-04-09.

emma_sales: Customer replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround and clear note. We'll confirm once credits show." :thumbsup:

ryan_fin: AP confirmed posting to April ledger. Finance closing ticket. Great cross-team response. :sparkles:
